# Inbound webhook routes and their gates

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/webhook-routes.mjs — do not edit by hand.
     tests/webhookSecretGuard.test.ts fails the gate if this drifts. -->

**None of these is public.** Every route below authenticates its caller before
doing anything, and every one refuses outright when its gating secret is absent
rather than comparing `undefined` to `undefined` and admitting everybody.

**A `GET` to any of them answers `405`.** The method check runs before the auth
check, so an unauthenticated probe is rejected on the method and never reaches
the secret comparison. That is why these can look unguarded from outside: the
405 says "wrong method", not "you are welcome here". Probe with `POST` and no
header to see the gate — you will get `401`.

| Route | Gate | Missing-secret behaviour | Writes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/api/members/create-free` | shared secret — `x-webhook-secret` header | lib/webhookAuth.ts (refuses 500 when WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset) | yes |
| `/api/members/create-paid` | shared secret — `x-webhook-secret` header | lib/webhookAuth.ts (refuses 500 when WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset) | yes |
| `/api/members/invite-beta` | shared secret — `x-webhook-secret` header | lib/webhookAuth.ts (refuses 500 when WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset) | yes |
| `/api/members/resume` | shared secret — `x-webhook-secret` header | lib/webhookAuth.ts (refuses 500 when WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset) | yes |
| `/api/members/suspend` | shared secret — `x-webhook-secret` header | lib/webhookAuth.ts (refuses 500 when WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset) | yes |
| `/api/stripe/webhook` | Stripe signature — `stripe-signature` header | inline (refuses 500 when the secret is unset) | yes |
| `/api/webhooks/resend` | Svix signature — `svix-*` headers | inline (refuses 500 when the secret is unset) | yes |
| `/api/zoom/webhook` | HMAC signature — `x-zm-signature` header | inline (refuses 500 when the secret is unset) | yes |

## Scope

This file covers **caller-authenticated webhook routes only** — the surface that
was previously mislabelled. It is not an inventory of every route in `api/`, and
the absence of a route here means only that it does not authenticate via a shared
secret or signature. Session-gated routes use `requireActiveUser` /
`requireAdmin` / `requireCapability`; read the handler.

`api/stripe/create-intent.ts` is deliberately **not** listed. It reads
`STRIPE_SECRET_KEY`, which is an outbound API credential rather than a gate, and
it is a public checkout endpoint by design.
